input.objective:
Deploy one contract on Sepolia: PondGuardHook, a Uniswap v4 hook for the existing token 0x1f9840a85d5aF5bf1D1762F925BDADdC4201F984 (UNI), paired with ETH. No new token and no pool created by the launch; the creator will initialize the pool with this hook afterwards on the PoolManager passed as a constructor argument (0xE03A1074c86CFeDd5C142C4F04F1a1536e203543).
The hook does exactly the following, and nothing else:
1. Take 1.0% of the ETH side of every buy and sell as a hook fee, settled in ETH inside the swap that paid it (mint a claim when the PoolManager cannot pay it directly), and send it to my wallet. Expose claimFees() that anyone may call to redeem claims to the recipient.
2. Liquidity added to the pool is locked for 7 days from the time it was added; removing it earlier reverts. The launch factory’s own zero-change fee collection is always allowed. Expose unlockAt(address) as a view.
3. The owner may pause and unpause swaps. Liquidity can always be removed while paused. Expose pause() and unpause() for the owner and paused() as a view.
4. For the first 15 minutes after the pool opens, only addresses the owner has added to an allowlist may buy. After that, anyone. Expose setAllowed(address[] accounts, bool allowed) for the owner and isAllowed(address) as a view.
5. Donations to the pool are allowed from only the owner; all other donations revert. Expose setDonor(address account, bool allowed) for the owner.
Owner the paying wallet may only: pause and unpause swaps, add and remove buyer allowlist addresses, change the donation allowlist, through the functions named above. No other admin function, no backend signer, no upgrade path.
Fees are always taken from the ETH (pair currency) side, never from UNI; a fee the PoolManager cannot pay directly is minted as a claim the recipient can redeem.
Take the PoolManager as a constructor argument and enable only the callbacks the behavior above needs. The deployed address must carry the correct hook permission bits (mine a CREATE2 salt). Owner, if any, is $owner.
Keep the function names exactly as written so the storefront can show them. Composed with The Hooks Store block builder.
